Dave Bronson

Registered Republican candidate for Governor / Lieutenant Governor, Alaska · Open seat

Former Mayor of Anchorage; pilot

Dave Bronson is a Republican and was the mayor of Anchorage from July 2021 to July 2024. He entered the governor's race on October 2, 2025. He finished fourth in the August 18, 2026 nonpartisan top-four primary and advanced to the November 3 general election, with Josh Church as his running mate.

Where Bronson stands

Permanent Fund dividend calculation
Says the dividend should be paid under the statutory fixed formula, and says he will not support a system where legislators reduce the check to cover spending.
Taxes
Opposes new taxes to pay for larger Permanent Fund dividends, saying life is already hard enough for Alaskans.
State revenue
Points to a gas line, less red tape for businesses, and private-sector growth as his answer to balancing the state budget, not new revenue measures.
K-12 school funding
Supports the state setting the funding formula and paying districts early on a predictable schedule. Wants districts to report in plain language how much money goes to classrooms versus administration.
State services and budget
Proposes a review of every state department and cutting programs that cannot show results. Says he would not cut troopers, classroom teachers, ferries or rural infrastructure, and would expand public safety and career and technical education.
Resource development
Says developing Alaska's resources will create good-paying jobs and bring royalty revenue to the state.

Background

  • Mayor of Anchorage, 2021–2024
  • Candidate for Alaska governor, 2026; advanced from the August 18, 2026 primary in fourth place
  • Pilot; U.S. Air Force, Air Force Reserve and Alaska Air National Guard
  • B.S., University of Wisconsin–Madison
  • Born 1958 in Superior, Wisconsin
